description: If total functions \(g,h\) are strongly represented in \(Q\), and a strongly represented total decoder codes every finite tuple, then the specified history formula strongly represents the function given by \(r(\bar x,0)=g(\bar x)\) and \(r(\bar x,i+1)=h(\bar x,i,r(\bar x,i))\).
signature:

  (hB : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.StronglyRepresents B decoder)
  (hcodes : ∀ (k : ℕ) (a : Fin k → ℕ), ∃ c d, ∀ (i : Fin k), B ![c, d, ↑i] = a i) (f : (Fin n → ℕ) → ℕ)
  (g : (Fin (n + 2) → ℕ) → ℕ) (base : Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula (Fin n ⊕ Unit))

  (hf : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.StronglyRepresents f base)

  Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.StronglyRepresents
    (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.primitiveRecFunction f g)
    (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.recursionGraph decoder base step)
